patterns.what_worked: Three read-only subagents split cache / portrait / diag, then every load-bearing claim was re-verified against file:line; client truth read branch-qualified from the mirror; every gate was actually run.
patterns.what_was_hard: The TBC 'unresolved unit' has two possible cause strings and the operator's exact text is unknown; the Era/TBC tooltip files are content-identical, so the difference is session state, not a client API.
patterns.skill_gap: The cache path has almost no offline pins; the portrait-side and diag-cache blocks are dead/unpinned, so a green suite does not cover them.
